entities.summary: Joy Emodi is an Educationist, Lawyer and a Nigerian Politician, who was elected Senator for the Anambra North constituency of Anambra State, Nigeria through court judgment, after Emmanuel Anosike's election annulled, taking office on 20 February 2005 after the election of Emmanuel Anosike was annulled. She was re-elected in 2007, but her second election was appealed by Alphonsus Obi Igbeke, the All Nigeria Peoples Party (ANPP) candidate. After protracted hearings, Igbeke was declared the winner on 25 March 2010.
